text: The NSIS helper records that it can return, then still processes subsequent requested associations before the final return check. This preserves combined requests such as mail/calendar and the new custom-link type. GNOME separately loops URI schemes and performs optional MIME/extension registration once afterward. These are exact per-platform ordering contracts, not evidence that registration succeeded or a general loop/return style rule.
title: Default-handler setup finishes selected associations before returning
